newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney details aluminum upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney details aluminum upgrade.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Victor Lazarovici said he upgraded two aluminum stocks, Aluminum Co of America and Reynolds Metals Co, to "buy" based largely on share price considerations.
-- He said he made no change in his target prices for the two stocks, which remain at $68 for Alcoa and $60 for Reynolds, nor did he raise his earnings estimates.
-- However, on October 16, he cut his 1996 estimate on Reynolds, he noted.
-- "It is more of an industry call than a (company-specific) call," the analyst said. "The adjustments that we made in our earnings estimates were done before."

-- In comment published Tuesday, he cut Reynolds' 1996 year estimate to $2.15 from $2.40 previously, in response to a disappointing earnings report. He made no change to his 1997 year estimate of $4.20 nor his 1998 estimate of $7.75.

-- Asked to explain the upgrade on Reynolds shortly after lowering his short-term outlook on the company, he said that, "I slept on it and decided there was still more going on" pointed to a positive outlook for the companies.
-- He said Alcoa remains his top pick of the year. "I still think it the strongest company in the industry and the stock that is most undervalued (in relation to its peers)."
-- Alcoa was up 7/8 of a point to 59-5/8 and Reynolds was up 2-1/8 to 57-3/8 in late afternoon trading Thursday.
